00 · Essentials0.1 · Introduction

Introduction

This is the Agensia Brand Book. It defines who we are, how we speak and how the identity is applied, in the shortest form that still governs the work. It is the controlled master for the confirmed logo, palette and typeface.
01

Read 01 first

Every visual rule that follows exists to carry the story in Brand. A layout that looks right but says the wrong thing has still failed.

02

Work from 03

Visual Identity is the working reference. Logo, colour and type rules are specified with values you can copy straight into a file.

03

Check 3.6 before you ship

The Logo Don'ts page is short on purpose. If your work appears there, change it.

04

Escalate anything else

This edition covers the essentials. Anything it does not answer goes to Brand Governance, on the closing page.

Brand promiseIntelligent Simplicity. Trusted Transformation.

01 · Brand1.1 · Company Introduction

Company Introduction

Agensia builds AI native, no code automation for enterprises that operate under regulation. Through one adaptive platform we help teams unlock scalable growth, intelligent workflows and regulatory compliance without replacing the systems they already rely on.

Powered by the SEAL engine, Self Evolving Agent Logic, our solutions deliver explainable, compliant automation that evolves with your operations rather than against them.

Digital transformation is not a one off project. It is a continuous journey. With Agensia you are not keeping up. You are staying ahead, with technology that listens, learns and leads.

01 · Brand1.4 · Values and Culture

Values and Culture

Six values, and each one is a test a release has to pass rather than a word on a wall.

Integrity

We build systems people can audit, question and trust. Transparency is a design decision, not a disclosure.

Adaptability

We design for change. Every system we ship is expected to evolve with the operation it supports.

Collaboration

We work alongside our clients rather than in front of them.

Empowerment

We remove friction so teams can do the work only humans can do.

Clarity

We reduce complexity at every level, from architecture to interface to the words we choose.

Resilience

We build for regulated environments where uptime, compliance and continuity are not negotiable.

Messaging Pillars

Every piece of Agensia communication ladders back to one of four pillars. If a claim cannot be traced to a pillar, it does not belong in the message.
Pillar 01

Adaptive by Nature

Systems that evolve with the operation rather than freezing it in place.

We adapt, so you do not have to rebuild.
Pillar 02

Explainable by Default

Every automated decision can be traced, audited and understood.

If it cannot be explained, it does not ship.
Pillar 03

Compliant from Day One

Regulatory readiness designed in, not retrofitted after launch.

Audit ready from the first deployment.
Pillar 04

Human in Command

Automation that expands judgement instead of replacing it.

Technology that listens, learns and leads.

03 · Visual Identity3.1 · Logo Overview

Logo Overview

The Agensia logo pairs a contoured symbol with the wordmark set in Ardela Edge. The symbol is built from concentric contour lines that resolve into an A, a form that reads as a system finding its shape rather than a static icon.

The horizontal lockup is the primary configuration. Use it wherever horizontal space allows. Alternative formats are specified in 3.3, and no other arrangement is approved.

3.113
03 · Visual Identity3.2 · Logo Concept

Logo Concept

The symbol is one curve drawn many times, each pass slightly offset. Four ideas hold it together.
Single Curve
One continuous curve, the simplest statement of the form. Everything in the mark begins here.
Offset Repetition
The curve redrawn many times, each pass set slightly inside the last. The mark is built the way a model converges: many iterations settling into one form.
Threefold Symmetry
Three lobes standing for the platform, the operation and the person. Balanced, and stable from any angle.
The Aperture
The open counter at the centre. It keeps the mark light at any size, gives the A its shape, and is the human space inside the system.
These four ideas combine to form the Agensia symbol: a mark that reads as a system finding its shape rather than a static icon. Its depth comes from line density alone, never from gradients or shading.

03 · Visual Identity3.9 · Typography

Typography

Agensia is set in Ardela Edge, the family the wordmark itself is drawn from. Its flat sided geometry and squared terminals give the brand its engineered edge at large sizes.

Ardela Edge is unicase. Sixteen of its twenty six lowercase letters carry their own outlines, but every one is drawn at cap height, so a paragraph set in it reads as capitals. It is a display face, and we use it as one.

Three faces carry reading text, each tied to a surface rather than a preference. Axiforma for brand and print, Inter for the website and the product interface, Arial for documentation and email. Choose by where the words will be read, never by taste.

JetBrains Mono handles technical annotation only: labels, colour values and specifications.

03 · Visual Identity3.11 · Language Variants

Language Variants

Where Simplified Chinese is required for interface, documentation or marketing material, Agensia uses Alibaba PuHuiTi. The family blends cleanly with the Latin system, holding clarity and technical elegance across a multilingual experience.

Weight mapping
Ardela EdgePuHuiTi 40 Bold
Axiforma SemiBoldPuHuiTi 25 Medium
Axiforma RegularPuHuiTi 20 Regular
Rules
Latin text inside a Chinese setting stays in Axiforma.
Never mix two Chinese families inside a single document.
Chinese sets around 4 per cent larger than Latin at the same nominal size.
Increase line height by one step when the two are mixed.
Alibaba PuHuiTi is not embedded in this document. The specimens above render in the reader's system Chinese face, so treat them as a layout reference. Install PuHuiTi to reproduce the setting exactly.

Rules
Two layouts are approved. Use the portrait version for client facing roles and the compact version for everyone else.
The whole signature is set in Arial. Email clients cannot embed a brand font, so no brand face is attempted here.
The portrait is a photograph of the person. Never an avatar, an illustration or the symbol.
Social icons are monochrome ink. Never brand green, never full colour.
The logo is the only green in the signature. Every line of text is ink or slate.
No rules, dividers or borders. Columns are separated by space alone, so the block survives a client that strips styling.
No quotes, awards, campaign banners or coloured disclaimers.
